request.prompt: Images 1-4 are reference photos of the masked person; match the mask shape, colour and headphones exactly. Black-and-white high-key 35mm film photograph, overexposed and airy, blown-out whites, heavy film grain, faint photocopy halftone texture, slight softness, editorial fashion photography. Everything is monochrome grey EXCEPT the mask, which keeps exactly its soft light mint-green paper colour from the reference images (do not saturate or brighten it) — the only colour in the picture. Lots of empty white negative space. Compose for a 16:9 crop. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark. Wide frontal shot: a perfect grid of about 30 people wearing the same mint-green paper ghost masks but WITHOUT headphones, in plain grey hoodies and black trousers, all facing the camera stand still in rows on a white floor, arms at their sides. In the exact centre, the masked person EXACTLY as in the reference images — copy the mask shape faithfully: a soft light mint-green crumpled-paper Pac-Man ghost mask, its silhouette is a pixel ghost with a stepped rounded dome top, straight sides and a pixel zigzag bottom edge, with some thickness but NOT a cube or box or cylinder; two black plus-sign eyes on the front; chunky faceted off-white pixel-block headphones with a stepped pixel headband over the dome and a thin black boom microphone from the right ear cup; oversized beige hoodie, black trousers. The mask face and the body ALWAYS face the same direction, toward the camera — the only one with headphones — tilts his head to one side, listening to music. Flat overexposed light.
